questions.en: Al2O3 · 2SiO2 · 2H2O is the chemical formula for
questions.hi: Al2O3 · 2SiO2 · 2H2O रासायनिक सूत्र है
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Hydrated aluminium silicate (Al2O3 · 2SiO2 · 2H2O) corresponds to the mineral kaolinite, commercially known as china clay.
questions.tip: Sand = SiO2; Bauxite = Al2O3 · 2H2O; China Clay (Kaolin) includes the silicate unit 2SiO2.

questions.en: Who among the following became India's unofficial Ambassador to England?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन इंग्लैंड में भारत के अनौपचारिक राजदूत बने थे?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Dadabhai Naoroji founded the East India Association (1866) and served as MP in the British House of Commons, championing Indian rights in Britain.
questions.tip: Dadabhai Naoroji formulated the 'Drain of Wealth' theory in 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: दादाभाई नौरोजी founded the पूर्व India Association (1866) and served as MP in the British House of Commons, championing Indian rights in Britain.

questions.en: Which of the following gases is considered as atmospheric pollutant?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी गैस वायुमण्डलीय प्रदूषक मानी जाती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sulphur dioxide (SO2), produced from burning fossil fuels and smelting ores, is a harmful primary atmospheric pollutant responsible for acid rain.
questions.tip: Normal air: N2 (78%), O2 (21%), Ar (0.93%); Pollutant gases: SO2, NO2, CO, O3 (tropospheric).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.en: Which of the following is not electromagnetic?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विद्युत्-चुम्बकीय नहीं है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Alpha rays are streams of particulate helium nuclei (4_2 He 2+) carrying mass and charge, whereas Gamma rays and X-rays are electromagnetic waves.
questions.tip: Electromagnetic: Radio, Micro, IR, Visible, UV, X-rays, Gamma rays. Particulate: Alpha, Beta, Cathode rays.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Alpha rays are streams of particulate helium nuclei (4_2 He 2+) carrying mass and charge, जबकि Gamma rays and X-rays are electromagnetic waves.
questions.tip_hi: Electromagnetic: Radio, Micro, IR, Visible, UV, X-rays, Gamma rays. Particulate: Alpha, Beta, Cathode rays.

questions.en: The electric fuse works on the

questions.en: What is the normal audible frequency range of sound waves for a healthy human ear?(
questions.hi: सामान्य स्वस्थ मानव कर्ण के लिए ध्वनि तरंगों की श्रव्य आवृत्ति परास (Audible frequency range) क्या होती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Human hearing spans 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz. Frequencies below 20 Hz are termed infrasonic (produced by earthquakes, elephants), and frequencies above 20 kHz are termed ultrasonic (utilized by bats, dolphins, and medical ultrasound).
questions.tip: Audible range = 20 Hz – 20 kHz; Infrasonic < 20 Hz; Ultrasonic > 20 kHz.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Human hearing spans 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz. Frequencies below 20 Hz are termed अवश्रव्य (इन्फ्रासोनिक) (produced by earthquakes, elephants), and frequencies above 20 kHz are termed पराध्वनि (अल्ट्रासोनिक) (utilized by bats, dolphins, and medical ultrasound).
questions.tip_hi: श्रव्य range = 20 Hz – 20 kHz; अवश्रव्य (इन्फ्रासोनिक) < 20 Hz; पराध्वनि (अल्ट्रासोनिक) > 20 kHz.

questions.en: In the Modern Periodic Table discovered by Henry Moseley in 1913, the physical and chemical properties of elements are periodic functions of their
questions.hi: 1913 में हेनरी मोजले द्वारा विकसित आधुनिक आवर्त सारणी में तत्वों के भौतिक और रासायनिक गुणधर्म किसके आवर्ती फलन होते हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Moseley demonstrated that X-ray frequency (√ν) is linearly related to atomic number (Z). The Modern Periodic Law states that properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic numbers (number of nuclear protons), resolving anomalies in Mendeleev's atomic mass arrangement.
questions.tip: Mendeleev = Atomic Mass; Modern Periodic Table (Moseley) = Atomic Number (Z).

questions.en: What is the primary combustible chemical constituent present in Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) and Biogas?(
questions.hi: संपीड़ित प्राकृतिक गैस (CNG) और बायोगैस में उपस्थित मुख्य ज्वलनशील रासायनिक घटक क्या है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Methane constitutes 75-90% of CNG and 55-70% of Biogas (gobar gas). Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) consists primarily of butane and propane.
questions.tip: CNG & Biogas = Methane (CH4); LPG = Butane + Propane.

questions.tip_hi: CNG & Biogas = मीथेन (CH4); एलपीजी (द्रवीभूत पेट्रोलियम गैस) = ब्यूटेन + प्रोपेन.

questions.en: Bihar possesses over 95% of India's total reserves of which mineral ore, mined primarily at Amjhor in Rohtas district?
questions.hi: बिहार के पास किस खनिज अयस्क का भारत के कुल भंडार का 95% से अधिक हिस्सा है, जिसका खनन मुख्य रूप से रोहतास जिले के अमझोर में किया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Amjhor in Rohtas district contains India's premier deposits of iron pyrites (FeS2), accounting for ~95% of total national reserves, utilized by Pyrites, Phosphates & Chemicals Limited (PPCL) to manufacture sulfuric acid.
questions.tip: Pyrite in Bihar = Amjhor (Rohtas) - 95% of India's reserves; Fools' Gold.

questions.en: The Standard Meridian of India (82°30' E longitude) passes through which of the following cities near Prayagraj in Uttar Pradesh?(
questions.hi: भारत की मानक याम्योत्तर (82°30' पूर्वी देशांतर) उत्तर प्रदेश में प्रयागराज के निकट किस नगर से होकर गुजरती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Indian Standard Time (IST) is calculated based on 82°30' E longitude passing through Shankargarh fort / Mirzapur near Prayagraj. It passes through 5 States: UP, MP, Chhattisgarh, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh, exactly 5 hours 30 minutes ahead of GMT.
questions.tip: Standard Meridian = 82°30' E (Mirzapur); Passes through 5 States (UP, MP, CG, Odisha, AP); IST = GMT + 5:30.

questions.tip_hi: Standard Meridian = 82°30' E (Mirzapur); Passes through 5 States (UP, MP, CG, Odisha, AP); IST = GMT + 5:30.

questions.en: Temporary hardness of water is caused by the presence of dissolved bicarbonates of which metals, and can be removed simply by boiling?
questions.hi: जल की अस्थायी कठोरता किन धातुओं के घुलनशील बाइकार्बोनेट की उपस्थिति के कारण होती है, जिसे केवल उबालकर दूर किया जा सकता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Temporary hardness is due to calcium bicarbonate Ca(HCO3)2 and magnesium bicarbonate Mg(HCO3)2. Boiling decomposes them into insoluble carbonates: Ca(HCO3)2 -> CaCO3↓ + H2O + CO2. Permanent hardness is due to chlorides and sulphates of Ca and Mg.
questions.tip: Temporary hardness = Bicarbonates of Ca & Mg (removed by boiling); Permanent hardness = Chlorides & Sulphates of Ca & Mg.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Temporary hardness is due to calcium bicarbonate Ca(HCO3)2 and magnesium bicarbonate Mg(HCO3)2. Boiling decomposes them into insoluble carbonates: Ca(HCO3)2 -> CaCO3↓ + H2O + CO2. Permanent hardness is due to chlorides and sulphates of Ca and Mg.
questions.tip_hi: Temporary hardness = Bicarbonates of Ca & Mg (removed by boiling); Permanent hardness = Chlorides & Sulphates of Ca & Mg.

questions.en: Which chemical element is used in the galvanization process to coat iron and protect it from atmospheric corrosion?(
questions.hi: लोहे को जंग से बचाने के लिए गैल्वनीकरण (यशदलेपन) प्रक्रिया में किस रासायनिक तत्व की परत चढ़ाई जाती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Galvanization coats iron sheets with molten zinc. Zinc forms a barrier layer of basic zinc carbonate and acts as a sacrificial sacrificial anode because its oxidation potential (-0.76 V) is more negative than that of iron (-0.44 V).
questions.tip: Galvanization = Coating of Zinc (Zn) on Iron (Fe).

questions.tip_hi: Galvanization = Coating of Zinc (Zn) on Iron (Fe).

questions.en: In which district of Bihar did the Salt Satyagraha of 1930 commence under the pioneering leadership of Bipin Bihari Varma at Goad?
questions.hi: 1930 में बिहार के किस जिले में विपिन बिहारी वर्मा के नेतृत्व में गोआड में नमक सत्याग्रह का शुभारंभ हुआ था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Champaran district, Salt Satyagraha began on 15 April 1930 under Bipin Bihari Varma (Chairman of District Board) at Goad, manufacturing contraband salt. Saran and Champaran were the first two districts in Bihar to inaugurate the salt march.
questions.tip: Salt Satyagraha in Champaran = Led by Bipin Bihari Varma; In Patna = Ambika Kant Sinha (Nakhas Pind).

questions.en: The River Burhi Gandak, an active northern tributary of the Ganga, originates from which physical feature in Bihar?
questions.hi: गंगा की उत्तरी सहायक नदी 'बूढ़ी गंडक' का उद्गम बिहार में किस भौगोलिक स्थल से होता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Burhi Gandak originates from Chautarwa Chaur near the Someshwar hills in West Champaran. It flows southeast through East Champaran, Muzaffarpur, Samastipur, and Begusarai before joining the Ganga near Khagaria.
questions.tip: Burhi Gandak origin = Someshwar Range (Chautarwa Chaur, West Champaran); joins Ganga at Khagaria.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: Burhi गंडक नदी origin = Someshwar Range (Chautarwa Chaur, पश्चिम Champaran); joins गंगा नदी at Khagaria.

questions.en: What type of soil, locally known as 'Balther Soil' (बलथर मिट्टी), occurs in a narrow transition belt between the southern alluvial plain and the Chota Nagpur plateau in Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार में दक्षिणी जलोढ़ मैदान और छोटानागपुर पठार के बीच संकीर्ण संक्रमण पेटी में पाई जाने वाली मिट्टी को स्थानीय रूप से क्या कहा जाता है?
options: Balther Soil (Red and Yellow sandy-clayey soil)
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Balther Soil (Red and Yellow sandy-clayey soil)
questions.explanation: Balther soil is an acidic, sandy-loamy to ferruginous soil with low water retention found along the Kaimur, Rohtas, Aurangabad, Gaya, Nawada, and Banka border foothills. Karail-Kewal is the heavy clayey alluvium of South Bihar.
questions.tip: Balther soil = Sandy, acidic foothills soil of South Bihar; Karail-Kewal = Heavy clayey alluvium.

questions.tip_hi: Balther soil = Sandy, अम्लीय foothills soil of दक्षिण Bihar; Karail-Kewal = Heavy clayey alluvium.

questions.en: Under Article 243D of the Constitution of India, what proportion of total seats in Panchayats is constitutionally reserved for women?
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 243D के तहत पंचायतों में महिलाओं के लिए कुल सीटों का कितना अनुपात संवैधानिक रूप से आरक्षित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Article 243D(3) mandates that not less than one-third of total seats shall be reserved for women in all Panchayats. (Note: States like Bihar have increased this reservation to 50% under state law, but the baseline constitutional requirement is 1/3rd).
questions.tip: Constitutional minimum (Art. 243D) = Not less than 1/3rd; Bihar State Law = 50% reservation.

questions.hi: कांसा (Bronze) मुख्य रूप से किन दो तत्वों से मिलकर बनी एक मिश्रधातु है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bronze is an alloy of Copper (~88-90%) and Tin (~10-12%). Brass is an alloy of Copper and Zinc. Solder is an alloy of Lead and Tin.
questions.tip: Bronze = Copper + Tin (Cu + Sn); Brass = Copper + Zinc (Cu + Zn); Solder = Lead + Tin (Pb + Sn).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: कांस्य (तांबा + टिन) is an alloy of Copper (~88-90%) and Tin (~10-12%). पीतल (तांबा + जस्ता) is an alloy of Copper and Zinc. सोल्डर (सीसा + टिन) is an alloy of Lead and Tin.
questions.tip_hi: कांस्य (तांबा + टिन) = Copper + Tin (Cu + Sn); पीतल (तांबा + जस्ता) = Copper + Zinc (Cu + Zn); सोल्डर (सीसा + टिन) = Lead + Tin (Pb + Sn).

questions.en: What is the normal physiological core temperature of a healthy human body on the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales?
questions.hi: सेल्सियस और फारेनहाइट पैमाने पर स्वस्थ मानव शरीर का सामान्य शारीरिक तापमान क्या होता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Normal human body temperature is 37°C, which converts on Fahrenheit scale as: F = (9/5 * C) + 32 = (9/5 * 37) + 32 = 66.6 + 32 = 98.6°F.
questions.tip: Normal body temperature = 37°C = 98.6°F = 310.15 K.

questions.en: What is the base SI unit of luminous intensity in physics?(
questions.hi: भौतिकी में ज्योति तीव्रता (Luminous Intensity) का मूल SI मात्रक क्या है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Candela (cd) is one of the seven base SI units, measuring luminous intensity in a given direction. Lumen is the derived unit of luminous flux, and Lux is the unit of illuminance.
questions.tip: Luminous Intensity = Candela (cd); Luminous Flux = Lumen; Illuminance = Lux.

questions.en: Which English natural philosopher first demonstrated that white sunlight is composed of seven constituent colours by passing it through a glass prism in 1665?
questions.hi: 1665 में कांच के प्रिज्म से गुजारकर सबसे पहले यह किसने प्रदर्शित किया था कि सूर्य का श्वेत प्रकाश सात संघटक रंगों से मिलकर बना है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sir Isaac Newton demonstrated spectrum dispersion using a triangular glass prism and verified that no further color splitting occurred, proving that white sunlight is inherently polychromatic (VIBGYOR).
questions.tip: Discovery of light spectrum through prism = Sir Isaac Newton.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Sir Isaac Newton demonstrated spectrum वर्ण विक्षेपण using a triangular glass prism and verified that no further color splitting occurred, proving that white sunlight is inherently polychromatic (VIBGYOR).
questions.tip_hi: Discovery of light spectrum through prism = Sir Isaac Newton.
